title: VAWA Reauthorization Act of 2013 — Pub. L. 113-4 — § 12491 Created; All Covered Programs; Emergency Transfer Plans; Self-Certification
enacting_law: Violence Against Women Reauthorization Act of 2013, Pub. L. 113-4, 127 Stat. 54, Title VI (Housing Provisions)
precursor_2005: VAWA 2005 (Pub. L. 109-162 § 606) — first housing protections; limited to public housing (§ 1437d) and Section 8 (§ 1437f)
key_additions_2013: § 12491 created — consolidated all VAWA housing protections
Covered housing program expanded to all HUD-assisted programs (including McKinney-Vento / CoC)
Emergency transfer plan — mandatory for all covered housing providers
Self-certification (HUD Form 5382) codified as sufficient documentation without police report
Confidentiality strengthened — shared database prohibition; written consent for disclosure
Annual tenant notice of VAWA rights required
most_recent_amendment: VAWA Reauthorization Act of 2022, Pub. L. 117-103, Division W, Title I
hud_implementing_regulation: 24 C.F.R. Part 5, Subpart L — effective November 16, 2016
homeward_bound_marin_note: Homeward Bound Marin — likely CoC / McKinney-Vento recipient; if confirmed, § 12491 applies to all admissions and placements; fabricated DV status admission = fraud on covered program
homeward_bound_marin_verification: HUD grants.gov — search Homeward Bound Marin as recipient
Marin Continuum of Care (CoC) — public program reports
verified_note: Legislative history from training knowledge. Pub. L. 113-4 text and vote counts are verifiable. HUD implementing regulation (24 C.F.R. Part 5 Subpart L) current text should be verified at ecfr.gov.
